mechanism: Both drugs cause nephrotoxicity and electrolyte depletion; foscarnet chelates divalent cations while furosemide increases urinary losses, synergistically impairing renal function and causing severe hypokalemia, hypocalcemia, and hypomagnesemia.
action: Monitor renal function and electrolytes closely; consider alternative diuretic or reduce furosemide dose; ensure adequate hydration and electrolyte supplementation during concurrent use.
